name: FSVR
_comment: Instrument (FS1R reconstruction). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is fsvr_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh: FSVR's engine (../src, unmodified) and its factory banks (../data, embedded by banks.S) are compiled in-process; no JUCE, no GUI, no ALSA.
